text: Based on the evidence, the owner did remove trees after 2020. The data shows tree-cover loss events in 2021 (81.3 ha), 2022 (0.6 ha), and 2023 (4.5 ha). These events are corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data, which indicates that the areas were forested in 2020. To determine if the law was broken, you would need to check local regulations regarding tree removal and compare the observed losses with permitted activities.
